en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own move and get the same condo, lease and visa groundwork for Bangkok
en.runTitle: A UK remote software contractor in Bangkok: a one-bedroom condo for THB 25,000–35,000 a month

fields.label: Arrival date and length of stay
Housing and living budget
fields.value: Housing of about THB 25,000–35,000 a month

fields.label: Preferred areas
fields.value: A one-bedroom condo near BTS or MRT in Ari, On Nut, Phrom Phong, Ratchada or Ekkamai

fields.label: Internet needs
fields.value: Good internet, in a building with a gym and pool

en.template: Help me plan a Bangkok move for {arrival}, with {budget}, {work}, {areas} and {internet}; compare lease terms, upfront cash, monthly bills and questions to settle before paying.

phases.title: Check current condo listings and the official visa and tenancy sources
phases.note: Five areas, the visa route, address registration, rental-contract rules and utility rates
phases.judgment: It did not repeat the common “one-month deposit cap”. The official 2025 rule limits advance rent plus deposit to three months, and only for landlords with at least three rental units, so a private owner may not be covered. It also dropped listings whose pages failed to load and flagged one advert that showed two different prices (THB 25,000 and 28,000).

phases.title: Write the guide page and the dated source list
phases.note: Neighbourhoods, listings, lease terms, visa, inspection checklist and monthly budget
phases.judgment: No advert could confirm that the flat would be free from 1 March 2027, so the guide says so openly and marks lease terms and facilities the adverts did not state, instead of filling the gaps.

phases.title: Run the final content, link and screen-size checks once

workers: Found and read exact rental listings for one-bedroom condos in Ari and On Nut
Found and read exact listings in Phrom Phong, Ekkamai and Ratchada, and checked that each page still loads
Read the official guidance on the Destination Thailand Visa, address registration (TM30), the 2025 rental-contract rules and water tariffs

zh.askTitle: 把格子换成你自己的搬家情况，得到同样的曼谷公寓、租约和签证准备
zh.runTitle: 在曼谷工作的英国远程软件承包人：月租 25,000–35,000 泰铢的一居室公寓

fields.label: 抵达日期和停留时间
fields.value: 2027 年 3 月 1 日起，停留 6–12 个月

fields.label: 偏好区域
fields.value: 靠近 BTS 或 MRT 的一居室公寓，区域可选 Ari、On Nut、Phrom Phong、Ratchada 或 Ekkamai

fields.label: 网络需求
fields.value: 网络要好，楼里有健身房和泳池

zh.template: 请按{arrival}、{budget}、{work}、{areas}和{internet}，帮我规划搬到曼谷的安排；比较租期、入住现金、每月账单，以及付款前要问清的问题。

phases.title: 核对当前的公寓房源，以及官方的签证和租赁来源
phases.note: 五个区域、签证途径、住址登记、租赁合同规定和水电费率
phases.judgment: 它没有重复常见的“押金最多一个月”的说法。官方 2025 年的规定是预付租金加押金合计不超过三个月，而且只适用于名下至少有三套出租房的房东，所以私人业主未必受此约束。它还剔除了页面打不开的房源，并标出一条同时出现两种价格（25,000 和 28,000 泰铢）的广告。

phases.title: 撰写指南页面和带日期的来源清单
phases.note: 区域、房源、租约、签证、看房清单和每月预算
phases.judgment: 没有一条广告能确认房子 2027 年 3 月 1 日起可入住，所以指南如实写明，并把广告中没写的租约条款和设施标为待确认，而不是自己补上。

phases.title: 最后一次性完成内容、链接和屏幕尺寸检查

workers: 查找并阅读 Ari 和 On Nut 一居室公寓的具体出租房源
查找并阅读 Phrom Phong、Ekkamai 和 Ratchada 的具体房源，并确认每个页面仍能打开
查阅官方关于泰国目的地签证、住址登记（TM30）、2025 年租赁合同规定和水费标准的说明
